row.notes: TrackModelComponent::initialise: resolves the track model and applies material overrides by context (SEASON, TRACK, Game.Context.overrideTrackName / Game.Context.TrackName), logs 'replace [%s]' and 'with [%s]', WARN 'Error material override [%s] doesn't exist for model [%s] using default.'. Addon/track mods: season/track material swaps on track models; for a missing override material nothing is overridden and only the WARN is logged. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner re-career-teams (independent agree V2833) | 2026-11-19 engine-re (corrected 2026-11-21 after V11908 and a second check): works on a local copy of the +0xe0 char* of the component that 0x143f9b3c0 finds by type 0x146cb7da0; the text up to and including '=' goes to a 0x400 stack buffer and the part after '=' is set to 'default'. A scenario gate ([0x14604c2c8]+0x30 map key 0x14604ed28, +8 +0x88 +0x260 +0xe18, word +0xb0 >= 0x100, low byte matched against the 16-byte entries [0x146079b28]+0x108..+0x110, g_Game_Scenarios) selects the SEASON/TRACK template instead: SEASON = the matched entry +8, TRACK = [[[[0x14601f5c8]+0x30]+0xe8]+0xa0]. With the bool setting Game.Context.overrideTrackName (Ne_Get_SettingBool 0x143a43b90 on [[[0x14601f5c8]+0x18]+0x18]) the part after '=' becomes Game.Context.TrackName (read into 0x1460790f0, cap 0x40), read every call for every track model (global, not per track). Logs 'replace [%s]' on the raw string and 'with [%s]' on the final buffer (two calls). The buffer is looked up via 0x143993660 in [[[[0x14601db08]+0x78]+0x20]+0x2268]; on a hit comp+0x58/+0x60 are written (0x142aa074f), on a miss (null or [res+0x28]==0) nothing is written and the WARN is logged when its channel is enabled (0x14604bac4). raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-19 at user request (lane owner review requested)
